transform_steps: Downloaded the official 3000x1549 PNG verbatim over HTTPS into a temporary location outside the repository.
Downscaled once to 640x330 with vipsthumbnail using a 640x640 bounding box, maximum PNG compression and metadata stripping.
Preserved the original aspect ratio, white field, colors and artwork; no crop, upscale, recolor or overlay was applied.
Verified the PNG signature, dimensions and 71581-byte size against the 96 KiB budget; the original bytes were not shipped.

fallback.purpose: Displayed only when the official PNG cannot be decoded.

display_rules.n2mobil: Rendered at its native 190x45 size inside a white chip; never upscaled.
display_rules.lavox: Rendered inside a white chip with object-fit: contain and a 320px inline-size cap; loading=lazy.
display_rules.hikvision: Existing first-party red and white wordmark is unchanged.
display_rules.fallbacks: Swapped client-side only on image error or cached decode failure; SVG titles and descriptions identify them as non-official approximations.
